items.title: Ola Electric Q2 revenue dips 39% as registrations slide
items.description: Ola Electric reported ₹421 crore in revenue for the September quarter, marking a 39% decrease from last year. The company ceased orders from direct-to-consumer stores as it shifts to a dealership model. Ola now has 255 dealer partners with over 300 stores to boost sales and reduce operating costs. Their net loss narrowed to ₹362 crore, despite lower vehicle registrations affecting their business.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers gains 16% in two sessions; analysts see 13% upside
items.description: In a bold move, Kalyan Jewellers India announced a significant 31% rise in revenue and a notable 64% boost in net profit. Plans include launching 84 new Kalyan stores along with expanding the Candere and Akshaya Thanga Maligai outlets. Analysts have expressed optimism, issuing 'Buy' ratings based on the growth from non-South markets, which climbed by 21%, positioning the company favorably against unorganized competitors amidst fluctuating gold prices.

items.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
items.description: MAN Industries (India) Ltd has announced a substantial increase in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also saw a notable rise year-on-year, reflecting strong performance. The acquisition of National Pipe Company has positively impacted scale and profitability for the firm. Shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily affected revenue but shipments are being executed.

items.title: Eicher Motors Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 1,573 crore, revenue jumps 20%
items.description: Eicher Motors reported a 15% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,573 crore, with record revenue of Rs 7,422 crore. Royal Enfield and VECV delivered strong sales growth, despite declining EBITDA margins.

items.title: Shriram Properties Q2 net profit rises 151%, revenue up 19%
items.description: Shriram Properties reported a 151% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 21.6 crore, supported by project completions and revenue growth. Revenue increased 19%, while operating profit surged 235%, reflecting improved margins and stronger real estate sales momentum.

items.title: Jagatjit Industries Q2 net loss narrows to Rs 4 cr, revenue rises 90%
items.description: Jagatjit Industries Ltd has reported a net loss of Rs 3.96 crore for the second quarter of FY27, significantly improving from Rs 27.91 crore lost during the same period last year. Total income surged to Rs 195.43 crore, up from Rs 103.11 crore. In the first half of FY27, the company posted an overall net loss of Rs 12.23 crore, a decrease from Rs 37.81 crore.

items.title: Tata Motors PV Q2 Results: Company reports net loss of Rs 5,531 crore; revenue jumps 34% YoY
items.description: Tata Motors PV Q2 Results: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles on Friday reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 5,531 crore for the September quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with a net profit of Rs 76,170 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. The company reported a one-time loss of Rs 6,738 crore for the quarter.

items.title: Kennametal India's July-Sep quarter PBT jumps to Rs 143 cr on strong hard metal volumes
items.description: Kennametal India reports over threefold growth in Q1 FY27 profit before tax to Rs 142.7 crore, while revenue surges 86.4% year-on-year. Strong hard metal volumes and favourable raw material pricing drive performance.

items.title: Grasim Industries Q2 Results: Standalone net profit zooms 187% YoY to Rs 2,306 crore, revenue jumps 33%
items.description: Grasim Industries Q2: Grasim Industries reported a standalone net profit of Rs 2,306 crore in Q2FY27, up nearly 187% year-on-year, while revenue surged 33% to Rs 12,746 crore. Shares, however, declined around 2% following the earnings announcement.
